mentions.h: League series starts with a win

mentions.note: first run for Belgrave, 13:09, third fastest of the day

mentions.h: Belgrave gain first triple win in South of Thames Championship since 1894
Belgrave Harriers top the Surrey C.C. League for the first time in 28 years
